## Wave 5 Summary

Wave 5 closes the three observational PBH/BAO carry-forwards surfaced by the S93 §VII.AX PBH-cluster close (W4-3/W4-5 + the S93 W-1 truncation-divergent-anchor workshop) and the session-x W4 OQ1 residual-open. The wave is observational/laboratory-IN throughout: every gate maps a substrate-IS spectral-triple observable (the cardinality-cascade edge count `N_eigs`, the per-branch Layer-1/Layer-2 sound speeds) to a laboratory-IN measurement context (the PBH number-density band-edge, the BAO acoustic-peak position) via the §VII.AX FWD-C5 cardinality bridge and the Layer-1/Layer-2 two-speed structure.

- **Item 14** (`S94-N-PBH-TRUNCATION-ANCHOR`) is the Tier-2-dimensionful re-anchorability problem. S93 W4-3 PROVED `N_eigs(L_max)` does NOT saturate (Sage-exact quintic; infinite SU(3) rep ring), so the `L_max=14` PROVISIONAL label on `n_PBH_FW_central` cannot be read off a non-existent eigenvalue-count plateau. Per `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Tier-1/Tier-2 dimensional-re-anchorability gate"`, the n_PBH m⁻³ Level-3 row is HELD `NOT-SATISFIED-PENDING-substrate-physical-scale-anchor`. This gate pre-registers, derives, and pins WHICH substrate-physical or laboratory-IN anchor sets the truncation — a `[CHAIN]` derivation gate, NOT a numerical-threshold gate.
- **Item 15** (`S94-N-PBH-BAND-BREACH-PROJECTION`) is a clean `[SIGN]`/threshold projection: from the W4-3 quintic + the `n_PBH(L)=central14·N_eigs(L)/N_eigs(14)` trajectory, find the smallest L_max with `n_PBH_central(L_max) > 2.2e-22` (the JE5 conjunct-upper ceiling). The S93 W-1 workshop already adjudicated L=18 as last-in-band and L=19 as first-breach; this gate LANDS that with a pre-registered threshold + the SIGN/MAGNITUDE/REGIME 3-tuple companion row.
- **Item 16** (`S94-BAO-PEAK-BRANCH`) computes the per-gapped-branch Layer-1/Layer-2 BAO-peak number — the genuine residual-open numbered-gate content of OQ1 LAYER-1-LAYER-2-DIFF-75 (the two-speed STRUCTURE is PROVEN in the cosmological tensor sector; the per-branch peak NUMBER was never run). Pre-registered per-branch peak-number prediction with band.

**Carry-forward source**: `session-93-w4-workingpaper.md:608-622` (items 14/15) + `session-x-w9-workingpaper.md:275-279` (item 16).             sourced from an N_eigs plateau and must be re-anchored to a substrate-physical scale

    Step 2 (Dimensional slot identification — write O(L,K)=W(L)·g(K) form):

        W(L_max) = n_edge(N_eigs(L_max)) = C(N_eigs(L_max), 2)   [carries the L_max-divergence; grows ~ N_eigs^2 ~ L^10]
        g(K)     = prob_form / L_pix_LRD^3                        [L_max-INDEPENDENT; carries the [m^-3] dimension]
      So n_PBH(L_max) = W(L_max) · g(K).
      BUT: the dimension [m^-3] is in g(K) (via L_pix_LRD^3) AND the divergence is in W(L_max) (via n_edge).
      These are SEPARATE multiplicative factors here — so naively this looks Tier-1-separable.

    Step 3 (Tier-2-dimensionful test — the divergence is NOT removable by a dimensionless ratio
            of THIS observable against itself, because n_edge has no continuum limit):
      lim_{L_max->inf} N_eigs(L_max) = +inf   [quintic, leading term (4/15)L^5; d/dL > 0 for all L>=1 — Step A confirms]
      => lim_{L_max->inf} n_edge = +inf       => lim_{L_max->inf} n_PBH(L_max) = +inf.
      There is NO c_continuum for n_PBH: the L_max->inf limit diverges. The m^-3 MAGNITUDE anchor
      (7.2761e-23 at L_max=14) is a finite-truncation read-off of a divergent quantity. Per the
      Tier-1/Tier-2 gate: a divergent channel whose anchor is a DIMENSIONFUL magnitude is
      Tier-2-dimensionful => registry-PASS-INELIGIBLE; the Level-3 m^-3 row is HELD.

    Step 4 (Admissible re-anchorings — the substitution chain forces the candidate set):
      (D1) Substrate-physical scale anchor: g_saturate = 143. For g >= 143 the cascade-tail edge
           count SATURATES at n_edge_saturated = C(N_eigs, 2) = 3.048e9 (S88 W1a-59 canonical, N_eigs
           from the L_max=10 base atlas = 78,080). This is a SUBSTRATE-PHYSICAL truncation: the cardinality
           cascade physically FILLS (g-axis, generation count), structurally DISTINCT from the N_eigs(L_max)
           eigenvalue-count growth (L_max-axis, rep-ring size). The saturation generation g_saturate is
           L_max-independent above saturation; it is a substrate-IS scale, NOT an eigenvalue-count plateau.
      (D2) Tier-2 dimensionless re-anchoring: define a log-derivative / ratio functional
           R[n_PBH] = d ln n_PBH / d ln (scale) that annihilates the L_pix_LRD^3 prefactor (the only
           operator killing the dimensionful prefactor W carrying the dimension), leaving a dimensionless
           truncation-invariant content — the §VII.AV.STATE-PROJ route. (Tier-2 re-anchored anchor.)

    Step 5 (Direction / selection — first-principles argument selects D1):
      The cardinality-cascade BRIDGE (FWD-C5) is built on the g-axis cascade (generation count), NOT
      the L_max-axis rep-ring growth. The substrate's PBH-formation physics terminates at cascade
      SATURATION (g_saturate=143), which IS the physical truncation of the cascade. The L_max=14 label
      was a confusion of the L_max-axis (eigenvalue-count, unbounded) with the g-axis (cascade-generation,

      m^-3 magnitude (7.2761e-23) at this anchor is a SATURATED-TAIL value, NOT a divergent-channel read-off.
      => Re-label: "L_max=14 PROVISIONAL" -> "g_saturate=143 cascade-saturation anchor (substrate-physical);
         m^-3 magnitude Level-3 row HELD Tier-2-dimensionful per cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md".

    Conclusion: The truncation anchor is the substrate-physical cascade-saturation generation
                g_saturate=143 (D1), NOT an N_eigs(L_max) plateau (which does not exist). The n_PBH m^-3
                Level-3 magnitude row is Tier-2-dimensionful and remains HELD NOT-SATISFIED-PENDING; the
                §VII.AX.OP-PROJ theorem-STRUCTURE stays STAGE-3-PERMANENT (Tier-2 corollary, per the gate).

      n_PBH_central(L_max) > 2.2e-22

        L=19: 1.247 (BREACH, 24.71% above ceiling).
